decisions.reason: Although a two-component resin injection unit fits our core plural-component and injection business, its disappearance from the website after 2019 suggests it was either replaced or did not earn enough demand to justify continued support as a standalone model.

This product is strategically close to our established application-equipment range, but no visible website presence after 2019 points to weak traction or replacement by newer variants, so we would phase it out.

Automatic airless spray guns are central to our offering, yet a model no longer shown after 2019 in a firm that markets precision equipment globally is likely obsolete or superseded and should be discontinued.

Manual airless spray guns are important to our business, but the lack of continued website listing after 2019 indicates this specific model is no longer worth maintaining versus newer or established alternatives.

Air-assisted airless technology matches our strengths, but because this product is no longer visible after 2019, management would likely reallocate resources to better-performing spray solutions or updated generations.
